features.privateDesc: Zero backend, zero cookies, zero trackers.

Common.aboutDescription: is a tool designed to work completely within your browser. All data processing and transformations are performed locally, ensuring that your sensitive information never leaves your device. This approach provides not only enhanced privacy but also superior performance by eliminating server round-trips.
Common.step1: Enter your input data into the editor or designated area.
Common.step2: Adjust any settings or parameters to match your specific needs.
Common.step3: The results will be generated instantly and ready for use.
Common.privacyDescription: Zply is built with a privacy-first mindset. Your data is never sent to a server for processing. This tool runs entirely in your local browser environment, making it safe for handling sensitive information without risk of leakage.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy & Security
PrivacyPolicy.description: Zply is built on a Privacy-First philosophy. We do not use cookies, and we do not collect any Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
PrivacyPolicy.zeroBackendDesc: Every tool runs 100% in your browser. No user-input data is ever sent to a server. For tools requiring external data (like IP detection), we always ask for your consent before any external request.
PrivacyPolicy.zeroCookiesDesc: We do not use cookies or persistent identifiers. Your browsing remains private and storage-free.
PrivacyPolicy.uriPersistenceDesc: Share your workspace state instantly. We use LZ-String compression to store your current state directly in the window.location.hash.
PrivacyPolicy.secureHashDesc: The text after the '#' symbol (the fragment identifier) in a URL is never sent to the server by the browser. Even if you share a link containing your data, only your browser (and whoever you share the link with) can see it. Zply never even knows what's in your hash.
PrivacyPolicy.telemetryDesc: To monitor site health and performance, we use Vercel Web Analytics. This integration is strictly for anonymous telemetry and does not track individual users.
PrivacyPolicy.noPiiDesc: Your IP address is hashed and discarded immediately; we never see who you are.
PrivacyPolicy.transparencyDesc: You can verify Vercel's privacy-first architecture in their official documentation.
